entities.summary: Hassanal Bolkiah, a notable figure in the history of Brunei, associated with Modern Brunei Darussalam (1984–2010). Preceded by Brunei joins ASEAN as its sixth member. Their legacy influenced Amedeo Development Corporation scandal involving Prince Jefri Bolkiah and Phased implementation of Sharia Penal Code.
